annotations.title: Solana transaction lookup: status, fee and signers

description: Look up a Solana transaction by signature, live from mainnet: success or the error, slot and block time, fee in SOL, compute units used, signers, the programs it called and SOL balance changes per account. Use to confirm a Solana payment landed or see what a transaction did. A signature that is not base58 is 400; an unknown or too old signature is 404, both uncharged. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
